evals.prompt: my express app on cohostly should greet the signed-in person by name and show a sign-in link to everyone else
evals.expected_output: Verifies the signed context token with the SDK (not raw headers), uses caller.name only when present and treats a missing name as unknown, and uses loginUrl for the sign-in link. Mentions that caller.name needs consent.

evals.prompt: I want to call claude from my cohostly app. where do i put the api key?
evals.expected_output: Explains the platform gives AI_BASE_URL and AI_API_KEY (the binding token), not a provider key. Says the AI binding may not be live yet and checks get_contract or describe_bindings before writing calls. Does not ask for or write a provider key.

evals.prompt: my app crashes on start on cohostly with 'port not listening' even though it works on my laptop
evals.expected_output: Checks the port the health check uses (health.port) against what the app listens on, notes that PORT is not confirmed as injected, and suggests confirming on a test deploy. Does not guess a random port fix without checking.
